image_description: A close-up shot of a slice of chocolate cake on a white plate. The cake is topped with pink and white whipped cream rosettes, garnished with small red berries and a sprig of greenery. Dark chocolate sauce is drizzled decoratively on the white plate in cursive-like patterns around the base of the cake.

This is a common AI artifact where the model mimics the structure of writing without understanding orthography.
The transition between the pink and white cream elements is slightly muddy and lacks the crisp definition of real piped cream. Some edges appear softly fused rather than distinct.
The bottom edge of the cake slice blends slightly into the plate shadow, lacking a sharp contact line. The geometry of the cake crumb looks somewhat smudged rather than porous.
